construction: Create a new PostgreSQL database for each cold run and apply the migrations at the commit in eval/run-freeze.json.

Load the retailer directory and source capabilities from the same directory snapshot as the warm runs (recorded in eval/run-freeze.json); load no corpus documents, observations, passages or embeddings.
Leave earlier run history and private buyer data out of the database.
isolation: The background ingestion worker is stopped for the whole evaluation.
Each cold run has its own database; whatever it writes is kept for audit and never reaches any other run.
No held-out answer, baseline output or verifier finding is ever written into a corpus.
